subject: Social Media
title: The Bystander Problem
description: A 60-second lesson on The Bystander Problem.

hook.text: You see a pile-on happening. You don't join. But you don't help either. You scroll past. So does everyone.

buildup.text: The bystander effect: people help less when others are present. Online, millions watch. No one acts.

discovery.text: Each person sees their tweet as minor feedback. They can't see the total: thousands of hate messages.

twist.text: No individual feels guilty because no individual caused the harm. But the collective harm is devastating.

climax.text: Defending a target risks becoming the next target. The cost of courage online is becoming the victim.

punchline.text: Nobody threw the stone. Everyone did.

quiz.question: Why don't bystanders help during online pile-ons?
options: Diffused responsibility and fear of becoming targets
